Punjab Sehat Card: How to Check Eligibility by CNIC

How to check Punjab Sehat Card eligibility online by CNIC, what the Sehat Sahulat programme covers, and how to use the card at an empanelled hospital.

Photo: Unknown photographer · Public domain · source

Short answer: The Punjab Sehat Card, part of Sehat Sahulat, gives eligible families free hospital treatment up to a defined limit per family per year. Check eligibility by CNIC on the official Sehat Sahulat or Punjab portal. Always verify on the official portal; eligibility and amounts change.

What the Punjab Sehat Card is

The Punjab Sehat Card, part of the Sehat Sahulat programme, provides free hospital treatment to eligible families up to a defined limit per family per year. It covers a list of inpatient treatments at empanelled public and private hospitals across the province.

Eligibility categories, the annual limit and the covered treatments change over time, so always check your own status by CNIC on the official Sehat Sahulat or Punjab portal. Verify on the official portal; eligibility and amounts change.

How to check your Sehat Card eligibility online

  1. Open the official Sehat Sahulat or Punjab Sehat Card portal.
  2. Find the eligibility or card-status check option.
  3. Enter the CNIC of the family head or the family member.
  4. Read the status: eligible, active, or not currently covered.
  5. Note the family limit and the helpline for hospital queries.

Enter your CNIC only on the official domain. Fake pages imitate the programme to capture personal data.

What the card usually covers

  • Inpatient treatment at empanelled hospitals, including surgery.
  • Maternity and some emergency care, as per the programme.
  • Tests, medicines and follow-up within the covered package.
  • A defined annual limit per family per year.

Outpatient visits, some cosmetic procedures and treatments outside the package are usually not covered. Ask the hospital's Sehat Card desk what is included before admission.

What to take to hospital

  • The patient's CNIC or the family head's CNIC, as the desk asks.
  • Any previous medical reports and prescriptions.
  • The mobile number linked to the family record.
  • Admission papers and, later, the discharge summary.

Visit the Sehat Card help desk before admission so staff can verify eligibility and open the case correctly. Keep a copy of every document you submit. If you are admitted in an emergency, tell the desk as soon as possible so the case can still be processed under the programme.

Checking for the whole family

The card is usually assessed for a family rather than one individual, so check the status of the registered family head and then confirm who is covered. If a family member is missing from the record, ask the desk or helpline how to correct it. Eligibility categories have changed over time, so do not assume automatic coverage; confirm on the official portal. Keep a screenshot of the eligibility result and the date you checked it.

How to use the card at hospital

Take your CNIC to an empanelled hospital and visit the Sehat Card or Sehat Sahulat help desk. Staff verify your eligibility online and, if you are covered, admit you under the programme. You should not be asked to pay for a covered treatment. Keep the admission papers and the discharge summary.

Avoid agents and scams

  • The card is free; no agent can sell you enrolment.
  • Never share your OTP, PIN or bank details for a card upgrade.
  • Do not pay cash to a middleman who promises free treatment.
  • Report a hospital that demands payment for a covered package.

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Reaching a non-empanelled hospital and then expecting free treatment.
  • Assuming outpatient medicines are covered when they are not.
  • Paying cash for a covered package without checking first.
  • Trusting a forwarded message about a new limit.

Frequently asked questions

How do I check my Punjab Sehat Card eligibility?
Open the official Sehat Sahulat or Punjab Sehat Card portal, choose the eligibility or card-status check, and enter the CNIC of the family head or member. Only use the official government domain.
What does the Sehat Card cover?
It usually covers a list of inpatient treatments at empanelled hospitals, including surgery, within a defined annual limit per family. Covered treatments and the limit can change.
Is the Sehat Card really free?
Yes for eligible families. There is no enrolment fee, and covered treatment should not be charged. Never pay an agent or a middleman for the card.
What if the hospital asks me to pay for treatment?
Confirm your eligibility on the official portal first. If the treatment is covered and payment is demanded, report it to the programme's helpline using the contacts listed on the official portal.
